title: Counting loops
description:
Write in `solution.c`:

```c
long long sum_to(int n);         /* 1 + 2 + ... + n; 0 when n < 1 */
int count_digits(long long n);   /* digits in n, ignoring a minus sign: 0 has 1 digit */
int is_prime(int n);             /* 1 if n is prime, else 0; numbers below 2 are not */
int gcd(int a, int b);           /* greatest common divisor of two positive numbers (Euclid) */
```

Euclid's method: while `b` is not 0, replace `(a, b)` with `(b, a % b)`. Then `a` is the answer.
hints: For `is_prime`, try every divisor `d` from 2 while `d * d <= n`: a number with a divisor bigger than its square root also has one smaller.
